## 🐛 Bug Description
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## 🔄 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. Scroll down to '...'
4. See error

## ✅ Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## ❌ Actual Behavior
A clear and concise description of what actually happened.

## 📱 Environment
**Device Information:**
- Device: [e.g. Samsung Galaxy S21, Pixel 6]
- Android Version: [e.g. 12, 13]
- App Version: [e.g. 1.1.0]
- RAM: [e.g. 8GB]
- Storage Available: [e.g. 32GB]

**App Information:**
- Installation Method: [APK Download / Play Store]
- First Time User: [Yes / No]
- Account Status: [Logged In / Guest]

## 📸 Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

## 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here. Include:
- Error messages (if any)
- When did this start happening?
- Does it happen consistently?
- Any recent changes to your device?

## 🔍 Possible Solution
If you have an idea of what might be causing the issue, please share.

## 📊 Impact
- [ ] Prevents app from launching
- [ ] Causes app to crash
- [ ] Feature doesn't work
- [ ] UI/UX issue
- [ ] Performance issue
- [ ] Other (please specify)
